title: Seva ya New Enchants
description: A datapack for the Seva ya Minecraft that adds new enchantments to the game.
body:
A datapack that adds the following new enchantments to the game.

Sword Enchantments (All incompatible with Sharpness/Smite/Bane):
- Humanity's Greatest Enemy: Deal more damage to villagers, illagers and players. Up to Level 5.
- Butcher: Deal more damage to passive mobs, also get extra drops when they die. Up to Level 5.
- Elemental Bind: Deal less damage to Slimes, Blazes, Magma Slimes and Breeze, also everytime you hit them there's a chance that they will drop items. Up to Level 5.
- Ender corruption: Deal more damage to ender enemies, also when you hit them their AI will get disabled for a short while. Up to Level 5.
- Sculk Thrive: While inside the Deep Dark each time you hit an enemy gain a potion effect, also you deal more damage. Up to Level 1.

Leggings Enchantment:
- Horse Legs: Gives you 0.5 step height per level. Up to Level 3.

New Curses:
- Curse of Big: Increases your size, step and jump height.
- Curse of Small: Decreases your size, step and jump height.
- Curse of Light: Gravity affects you less, fall damage unchanged.
- Curse of Heavy: Gravity affects you more, fall damage unchanged.
- Curse of Ciocolatta: Any fall will kill you, even a the fall from a carpet to the floor.
- Curse of Netherrack: Once ignited, you will burn forever.
- Curse of Flat: You have no step height.
- Curse of Bad Luck: Reduces your luck massively.
